summary: Iteration 6: Verified settlement-as-cutoff semantics. Backend pytest 8/8 passed covering Scenarios A-D and regressions. Frontend @420px verified optimistic Mark Settled zeros all 4 stat tiles within 350ms and Undo restores full history.
critical_code_review_comments: compute_worker_ledger correctly uses $gt cutoff (exclusive of settlement date) on attendance/advances/returns — matches spec 'inclusive-of-cutoff'.
total_settled sums ALL historical settlements (not filtered by cutoff) which is correct for cumulative reporting.
settle() endpoint still records amount = pending BEFORE inserting new settlement (compute happens with previous cutoff) — correct.
Ledger.jsx optimistic update matches backend formula: zeroes days/earned/advance/returned/net_advance/pending; adds prev.pending to total_settled.
server.py is now ~1367 lines — consider splitting into modules (pre-existing, non-blocking).
